consent.title: Before we start
consent.intro: Shubhvela works without an account. Here is exactly what happens with your data.
consent.whatStored: The birth details, names, relationships and family dates you enter, your reminder choices, journal notes and settings.
consent.where: Only on this phone, in the app's own database. There is no account and no Shubhvela server.
consent.leavesTitle: The one time data leaves the phone
consent.leaves: When you tap “Search online” while entering a place, the typed place name is sent to OpenStreetMap (Nominatim) to find its coordinates. Nothing else is sent anywhere.
consent.ads: The free version shows ads through Google AdMob, which asks for its own consent and follows its own policy. Pro removes every ad.
consent.delete: Settings → Privacy → Delete everything removes all data at once. Uninstalling the app does the same.
consent.grievanceProvisional: This contact address is provisional and will be confirmed before release.
consent.law: Processed under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 and its Rules.
today.title: Today
today.flagBhadraEarth: Bhadra on earth {from}–{to}: no new beginnings
today.flagBhadraHeaven: Bhadra in heaven {from}–{to} (no effect on earth)
today.flagBhadraPatal: Bhadra in the netherworld {from}–{to} (no effect on earth)
today.segmentsFooter: Tap a segment for its “Why?” (rule, weekday and sunrise inputs). One rule colours both the band and this list: Avoid = Rahu Kaal, Yamaganda, Gulika, Kaal/Rog/Udveg choghadiya; Good = Abhijit, Brahma muhurat, Shubh/Labh/Amrit choghadiya minus Avoid; Neutral = Chal and the rest. Bhadra and Panchak are flags, not colours.
today.noteFooter: Guidance for reflection, computed from your chart and today's sky. Not a prediction.

family.title: Family

family.remindersNote: Reminders are scheduled on this phone only; nothing is sent to a server. Quiet by default: only the dates you switch on. Each switch counts once toward the free limit, however many days it reminds you. Shraddha records do not use a profile slot.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.summary: No account. Everything you enter stays in this phone's database. Nothing is uploaded to Shubhvela.
privacy.storedList: Profiles and birth details · ancestors and family dates · reminder settings · journal · app settings
privacy.networkList: Online place search (only when you tap it, to OpenStreetMap Nominatim) · ads in the free version (Google AdMob) · Play purchases (Pro)
privacy.nominatim: Online place search sends only the town name you typed, identified as Shubhvela, to OpenStreetMap Nominatim. Only the town you choose is kept.
privacy.deleteAllBody: Removes every profile, family date, reminder, journal entry and setting from this phone. This cannot be undone.
privacy.grievanceNote: Complaints are answered within the period set by the DPDP Rules.
privacy.breach: Shubhvela has no server, so a data incident can only concern this phone. The process is published on the website.
disclaimer.title: Disclaimers
disclaimer.reflection: Shubhvela offers guidance for reflection, computed from classical rules and today's sky. It does not predict events.
disclaimer.notAdvice: Nothing here is medical, legal or financial advice. For such matters, consult a qualified professional.
disclaimer.noGuarantee: No outcome is promised or guaranteed, and nothing is sold or recommended to change one.
disclaimer.short: Guidance for reflection · not advice · no promised outcome
about.title: About
about.whatItIs: An offline Vedic almanac: panchang, kundli, dashas, family tithis and muhurat, computed on this phone.
about.engine: Computation: astronomy-engine ephemeris, Lahiri ayanamsa by default, a vendored jyotish fork (ISC).

varshaphal.title: Varshaphal
varshaphal.yearBeginsBody: Your Vedic year begins {date} at {time}. Open Shubhvela for the year's chart.
varshaphal.approxMoon: Birth time unknown: Muntha from the Moon sign, approx.
varshaphal.howComputed: How this was computed: solar return by search on the sidereal Sun ({ayanamsa}); chart at {place}; Muntha from the natal Lagna; year lord by the five-candidate Tajika rule with Panchavargiya bala; Mudda dasha in Vimshottari proportions from the natal Moon's nakshatra lord; {node} node.
muhurat.title: Muhurat finder
muhurat.freeNote: Free plan searches today + 7 days. Any range and .ics export with Pro.
muhurat.windowRule: Windows are choghadiya segments outside Rahu Kaal; neighbours that pass the same rules are merged.
muhurat.zeroResults: No window met at least 4 rules in these days; widen the range (Pro) or see the best partial matches
muhurat.howComputed: How this was computed: candidate windows are the day's choghadiya segments outside Rahu Kaal, scored against the activity's rule table (tithi, nakshatra, vara, Chandra bala, Tara bala, Rahu Kaal, Bhadra, Panchak, Abhijit, choghadiya). Scores are counts of rules met, not probabilities. Windows meeting fewer than 4 rules are listed only under “best partial matches”.
